round_a_candidates.label: fixed_1024_overlap_0_encoder_truncates_at_512
round_a_candidates.note: BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 effective passage-embedding limit is 512 tokens (verified against the cached model config, not assumed) - SentenceTransformer.encode() silently truncates; only the first ~510 content tokens contribute to the vector. Full 1024-token chunk text is preserved in the chunk artifact.

phase3_2_config.round_b_policy: After Round A metrics are complete, select the best fixed window via the frozen Stage 8 winner-selection rule (src.eval.phase3_ablation.select_round_winner). Then evaluate B0 (winner window, overlap 0 - reused from Round A, never rebuilt), B1 (winner window, 12.5% overlap), B2 (winner window, 25% overlap). overlap_tokens looked up from the fixed table (never computed by rounding at runtime): 256->32/64, 512->64/128, 1024->128/256 (src.eval.phase3_ablation.OVERLAP_TOKEN_TABLE). stride_tokens = window_size_tokens - overlap_tokens; no other overlap definition is used.
phase3_2_config.round_c_policy: After Round B metrics are complete, select the winner window+overlap via the same frozen rule. Then compare C0 (that fixed-window winner, reused from Round B, never rebuilt) vs C1 (identical window/overlap/tokenizer/partial-window policy, but split_mode=section_aware: chunks never cross a normalized '## Item ...' heading boundary - src.chunk.fixed_window.split_body_into_sections). No LLM, no table reconstruction, no rewritten text, no fabricated section metadata, no duplicated section titles prepended to continuation chunks.
phase3_2_config.metric_definitions: doc_recall@10 / doc_recall@50 / doc_mrr / doc_ndcg@10 via src.eval.baseline_metrics (Task 1.10) + src.eval.metrics (Task 2.6) + src.eval.phase3_baseline.document_relevances_at_k (Task 3.1's nDCG double-counting fix) - unmodified from Task 3.1 row 0. chunk_recall@10, chunk_mrr, faithfulness, citation_grounding, and generation metrics remain N/A (no valid chunk-level or generation gold exists) - N/A is never reported as 0.
phase3_2_config.winner_selection_policy: Task 3.2 prompt Stage 8: primary priority order doc_recall@50 > doc_mrr > doc_ndcg@10 > doc_recall@10 (src.eval.phase3_ablation.QUALITY_PRIORITY_KEYS); practical tie iff Recall@50 differs by <=1/89 AND paired MRR delta's 95% CI includes 0 AND paired nDCG@10 delta's 95% CI includes 0 (is_practical_tie); tie-break order: fewer chunks/duplication -> smaller embedding artifact -> smaller index -> lower retrieval p95 -> lower build cost -> simpler policy, fixed before section_aware (apply_tiebreak); a candidate that raises Recall@50 with a credible (95% CI entirely below 0) MRR or nDCG@10 regression is flagged for a user decision rather than auto-selected (select_round_winner's regression-protection branch).

A2.label: fixed_1024_overlap_0_encoder_truncates_at_512
A2.encoder_truncation_note: BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 has a 512-token effective passage-embedding limit (sentence_bert_config.json max_seq_length=512, tokenizer_config.json model_max_length=512, BertModel max_position_embeddings=512 - all verified against the cached model, not assumed). Verified empirically: SentenceTransformer.encode() silently truncates to the first 512 tokens (including [CLS]/[SEP]); the embedding of a chunk longer than that is bit-identical to the embedding of its first ~510-content-token prefix. This 1024-token chunk configuration is therefore NOT a lossless 1024-token embedding experiment - only the truncated prefix contributes to the vector, though the full chunk text is preserved in the chunk artifact for inspection.

A.rationale: A1 is a credible improvement over reference A0 on the frozen priority order with no regression-protection violation.

B.rationale: B1 ranks best by raw metrics but is practically tied with reference B0 (Recall@50 hit delta=1, MRR/nDCG@10 95% CIs include 0); engineering tie-break selected B0 among 3 tied candidates.

C.rationale: C0 ranks best on the frozen priority order (doc_recall_at_50, doc_mrr, doc_ndcg_at_10, doc_recall_at_10); engineering tie-break selected C0 among 2 practically-tied candidates.

rationale: Round A selected A1 (A1 is a credible improvement over reference A0 on the frozen priority order with no regression-protection violation.). Round B selected B0 (B1 ranks best by raw metrics but is practically tied with reference B0 (Recall@50 hit delta=1, MRR/nDCG@10 95% CIs include 0); engineering tie-break selected B0 among 3 tied candidates.). Round C selected C0 (C0 ranks best on the frozen priority order (doc_recall_at_50, doc_mrr, doc_ndcg_at_10, doc_recall_at_10); engineering tie-break selected C0 among 2 practically-tied candidates.). Final frozen Task 3.2 chunking strategy: fixed window=256 tokens, overlap=0 tokens, split_mode=fixed.
limitations: Evaluated only over the frozen Task 3.1 89-question DEV/evaluable-subset (4.9% of full DEV) - not a full-DEV or TEST result.

N=89 is small; practical-tie handling and bootstrap CIs govern which differences are treated as credible, per the frozen Stage 8 rule - small point-estimate differences (e.g. A1 vs row 0's MRR/nDCG@10) are not claimed as regressions unless their 95% CI excludes 0.
The 1024-token (A2) candidate is not a lossless 1024-token embedding experiment - BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 truncates to ~510 content tokens; only that truncated prefix reaches the vector.
Section-aware splitting (C1) uses only the already-normalized '## Item ...' headings; it does not reconstruct tables, rewrite text, or inject summaries.
chunk_recall@10, chunk_mrr, precision@5, faithfulness, citation_grounding, and generation metrics remain N/A throughout - no valid chunk-level or generation gold exists for this scope.
Comparative-question categories (year-over-year, cross-entity) have zero coverage in this scope (inherited from Task 3.1) and are not represented in any Task 3.2 metric.
